text: UT Dallas > University Career Center > 12twenty@UTDallas for Log In to Your Student/Alumni Account. If you are a current student, log in today using your UT Dallas Single Sign-On (SSO). Please do not create a new account. LOG IN – UT DALLAS SSO. If you are alumni, please reach out to 12twentySupport@utdallas.edu to activate your account. Getting started only takes a few minutes. Once logged in, complete the recommended profile steps to receive the most relevant opportunities and resources for you.

Appointments, jobs, and events are now being managed through 12twenty only. The last day to access Handshake to gather any of your application materials is August 31, 2026. If you have any questions, please reach out to 12twentySupport@utdallas.edu for assistance. The University of Texas at Dallas Student Services Building 3.300. 800 W.
